about_short_description.short_description: UBR is an e-sports industry that aims to provide a virtual reality experience for gaming enthusiasts.

product.name: UBR VR Arenas
product.description: Physical locations equipped for virtual reality gaming experiences supporting multiple players and game modes.

product.name: Team Death Match Mode
product.description: A VR game mode where two teams compete, with players respawning and using multiple weapons and killstreak powerups.

product.name: Co-op Zombie Mode
product.description: A cooperative VR game mode where players defend against waves of zombies, upgrading weapons to survive increasing difficulty.

product.name: UBR VR Ramadan Tournament
product.description: An annual VR gaming competition held during Ramadan, featuring cash prizes and open to players of all skill levels.

product.name: UBR Franchise Opportunities
product.description: A business model allowing individuals to open and operate UBR VR gaming centers with provided hardware and support.
